name: Being Grateful
overview: Scripture calls believers to a life marked by gratitude, recognizing that all good gifts come from God whose mercy endures forever (Psalms 118:1). Being thankful is closely tied to faith and salvation, as grace is a divine gift received through faith (Ephesians 2:8), and believers are urged to live as God’s children, embodying thankfulness in their hearts and prayers (Ephesians 5:1; Colossians 3:15; Colossians 4:2). This grateful attitude flows from trusting God as the one who rewards those who diligently seek Him (Hebrews 11:6), making gratitude an essential expression of faith and dependence on God’s goodness.
